definitions.short: Abital , a wife of King David
definitions.full: H37. Abital אֲבִיטָ֑ל proper name, feminine ( my father is (the) dew ) a wife of David 2Sam 3:4 ; 1Chr 3:3 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1 and 2919 ; father of dew (i.e. fresh);
